what: *** SHE IS THE FIRST NAME ON THE PAGE ***

certainty: *** SECURE. *** Found only after scanning the column end to end and then going back ABOVE the starting point - *** she was above it the whole time. ***

what the page shows: *** MANUEL, 20, 'Africana' *** and *** ROSA, 12, 'Oriental' ***, both entered with a ditto mark where a surname would go.
certainty: *** THE NAMES AND AGES ARE SECURE; WHAT THEY WERE TO HER IS NOT. *** 'Africana' means African-born, and *** in a Montevidean house of this period that ordinarily means an enslaved or formerly enslaved person ***, taking the householder's surname. *** The page states no relationship and none is asserted *** - but it is the same shape as Sancho's household in 1812, and this archive now names those four.

what: *** WHAT MAKES HER WORTH THE ROW ***
what the page shows: *** A Spanish-born LLERENA woman of sixty, keeping her own house in Montevideo. ***
certainty: *** Sancho was ANDALUZ and 45 in 1812. *** Depending on this census's date she stands *** in his generation or the one above it ***, which is precisely the generation row 22 is stuck on. *** She is attached to him by nothing and is not claimed. ***

what: *** AND THE DATE OF THIS CENSUS IS NOT ESTABLISHED ***

what: *** THE VOLUME IS IDENTIFIED, AND THE YEAR IS STILL NOT ***
